item.text: The interface and engine methods are in place. Next I’m wiring the interceptor to treat namespace listing specially: evaluate the namespace decision, store its result in context, and skip the ordinary “read namespace with no namespace scope” decision that causes the reported 403. Then I’ll filter the service response and make sure legacy policies that omit this new decision fail clearly.

The focused Go test command is still compiling/running and hasn’t reported a failure. I’m also updating the existing Rego test policy with an explicit namespace decision; that gives the engines a concrete policy contract and covers the role combinations described in the issue.

item.text:
Implemented namespace access evaluation in both authorization engines, special handling for `ListNamespaces` in the gRPC middleware, and context-based namespace filtering in the endpoint.

Added Rego engine coverage and a namespace filtering test. Verification passed: `go test ./internal/server/authz/... ./internal/server` and `git diff --check`.

One limitation: `TotalCount` for filtered results is calculated from the current page after filtering, so it may not reflect all accessible namespaces when pagination is used.
